description: Create a new Bot Office with no credential (same as POST /v1/workspaces; 10 per address per hour). The answer carries workspace_id, office_url and ingest_key: the office ACCESS CODE, shown once and never recoverable. Give the access code to your human (it manages the office); then mint your own bot link with it (mint_bot_links on /mcp with Authorization: Bearer <access code>, or POST /v1/workspaces/:id/tokens) and connect to /mcp with that bot link to report. Example: {"name":"Acme Dental","url":"https://acme-dental.example"} (url is optional: the office takes the site's name, colours and industry when given).

kit.description: Industry kit id when you know it (e.g. generic, dental, gov-cyber, msp). Optional.

name.description: The organisation's name (shown on the office).

url.description: The organisation's website, http(s). Optional: used for the name, colours and industry kit.

name: create_office
title: Create an office
